name: ChuSinGura 46+1
source: The protagonist Fukami Suguha visits the historic graves of the forty-seven Akou rounin on New Year's Day, but suddenly blacks out while observing the solar eclipse. He wakes up in the body of an Edo period samurai with the same name and face. Suguha is forced to adjust to life in the year 1701 as history unfolds, while getting to know the forty-seven rounin, whose personal details closely match history--except that many of them are women.
translation: 主人公深见叶在元旦参观赤穗四十七浪士的历史墓地时，在观察日食时突然昏倒。他在一个同名同姓的江户时代武士的身体中醒来。随着历史的展开，杉叶被迫适应1701年的生活，同时逐渐认识四十七浪士——他们的个人信息与历史高度吻合，只是其中很多人是女性。
